basic_details.job_title: Satavahana University Part-Time Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 9 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Satavahana University, Karimnagar, has invited applications for 9 Part-Time Faculty posts for the academic year 2026-27. The posts are in four subjects: M.COM (Fin Tech), MSW, M.SC (Food Science & Nutrition) and M.SC (Forensic Science). Candidates submit the application form, a complete bio-data and the relevant documents as a hard copy at the office of the Registrar, Satavahana University, Karimnagar. The application must be in the office by 5.00 p.m. on or before 31 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: About Satavahana University
content_sections.text: Satavahana University is a university in Karimnagar, Telangana. Its office is on Malkapur Rd, Chinta Kunta, Karimnagar – 505002. Through this notification, dated 23 October 2026 and signed by the Registrar, it is filling new part-time teaching services in its Social Sciences and Sciences groups for the academic year 2026-27.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is submitted as a hard copy in the office of the Registrar. The notice does not mention applying online or by email. Applications go to this address: The Registrar, Satavahana University, Malkapur Rd, Chinta Kunta, Karimnagar – 505002, Telangana Fill in the "Application Form for Part-Time Teaching" printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notification. It asks for personal details, category (OC / SC / ST / BC (A, B, C, D, E)), addresses with PIN code, mobile number and email, academic qualifications with marks, research degrees, teaching and research experience, fields of specialisation and research publications. Sign the undertaking at the end of the form, which certifies that the information is correct. Prepare a complete bio-data with the details listed under Enclosures below. Attach attested photocopies of your certificates and other documents. Submit the form, the bio-data and the documents as a hard copy in the office of the Registrar at the address above, by 5.00 p.m. on or before 31 October 2026. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 9 vacancies are for the post of Part-Time Faculty. The notice lists them subject by subject, with the Rule of Reservation (ROR) roster points for each: The notice prints one set of eligibility criteria for all the services: Master's Degree with 55% Marks in relevant subject (50% SC/ST). The candidates must have cleared the NET/SET/SLET. Candidates who have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the UGC Regulations, 2009 or 2016 are exempted from NET/SET/SLET. Preference will be given to candidates with Ph.D. Qualification and Teaching Experience. The remuneration to the part-time teachers will be paid as per the Satavahana University approved rates and the actual number of classes taken in a semester as per almanac. The notice does not print an amount. Part-time teachers are not entitled to any benefits from the University except the earmarked wages of part-time teaching arrangements, and they are in no way comparable to the regular teachers. The appointment is made purely on a temporary basis and may be terminated without any prior notice. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Completed Application Form for Part-Time Teaching, signed by the candidate. Complete bio-data, including name, address, mobile number, e-mail address, educational qualification (with details of marks obtained), the copy of the Ph.D. Degree, and teaching and research experience. Attested photocopies of certificates and other documents. Copies of certificates for academic qualifications (SSC/Xth Std., Intermediate/XIIth Std., Undergraduate, Post-Graduate and other examinations, if any). Copies of certificates for research degrees (M.Phil., Ph.D., D.Sc. / D.Litt.), where held. A separate sheet listing research publications (title, journal name, volume number, year of publication), if needed.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A selection committee will scrutinise the applications on the basis of educational qualification, a demo and interview, and the Rule of Reservation. Educational Qualification: Applications are scrutinised on qualifications. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interviews. Demo & Interview: Shortlisted candidates give a demo and attend an interview. The date of the interview will be announced later. Rule of Reservation: The Rule of Reservation is followed, using the roster points shown in the vacancy table. The candidate scoring high marks will be considered for appointment.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Satavahana University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 Part-Time Faculty vacancies: 2 in M.COM (Fin Tech), 2 in MSW, 2 in M.SC (Food Science & Nutrition) and 3 in M.SC (Forensic Science).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Satavahana University Part-Time Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted in the office of the Registrar by 5.00 p.m. on or before 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Satavahana University Part-Time Faculty?
faq.answer: A candidate needs a Master's Degree with 55% marks in the relevant subject (50% for SC/ST) and must have cleared NET/SET/SLET. Preference will be given to candidates with a Ph.D. qualification and teaching experience.

faq.question: Q4. Is NET/SET/SLET compulsory for Satavahana University Part-Time Faculty posts?
faq.answer: NET/SET/SLET is required, but candidates who have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the UGC Regulations, 2009 or 2016 are exempted from it.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Satavahana University Part-Time Faculty?
faq.answer: Remuneration is paid as per the Satavahana University approved rates and the actual number of classes taken in a semester as per almanac. Part-time teachers get no other benefits from the University beyond these earmarked wages.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for Satavahana University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the Application Form for Part-Time Teaching, a complete bio-data and attested photocopies of your certificates as a hard copy to The Registrar, Satavahana University, Malkapur Rd, Chinta Kunta, Karimnagar – 505002, Telangana, by 5.00 p.m. on 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Satavahana University Part-Time Faculty?
faq.answer: A selection committee scrutinises applications on the basis of educational qualification, a demo and interview, and the Rule of Reservation. Only shortlisted candidates are called for interview, and the candidate scoring high marks will be considered for appointment.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Satavahana University Part-Time Faculty job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is for the academic year 2026-27 and is made purely on a temporary basis. It may be terminated without any prior notice.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the Satavahana University interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, and the interview date will be announced later.
